comparison.objective: Disinfect an IV connector for 15 seconds before seating a syringe and flushing the line.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed frictional wiping, precise luer alignment/insertion, and controlled plunger actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Hub receives 15 seconds of qualifying scrub before any syringe contact, syringe seats, at least 5 mL leaves the barrel and at least 4.5 mL is collected with limited loss; early contact forces zero.
comparison.reason: The hardest ability is ordered contamination-safe cleaning and fluid-line access, not preserving an adjustable mechanical setting while tightening a locknut.
